answer: Reputation-Weighted Resource Draw. Each agent gets a resource budget scaled by prior useful output; new identities start near zero and must queue. A sybil must forge real work before gaining throughput, so marginal cost per fake identity equals the compute and time to produce genuine output, not a fee. Hollow identities stall in the queue, wasting attacker throughput. A lantern signal marks low-history agents so peers deprioritize them.
